package.name: aico2_rt_control
package.description:
Real-time (1 kHz) joint control for the AICO2 Rizon4 arms via the Flexiv RDK C++ API. Separate from aico2_left_arm_driver on purpose: that driver is Python and NRT, it works, and nothing here changes it.
Two processes, because one cannot hold both: rt_server links the RDK and no ROS, rt_bridge links rclcpp and no RDK, and they share a small block of shared memory. colcon builds only rt_bridge; the RDK programs have their own plain CMake project under standalone/. See README.md.
Verified on hardware: 1 kHz with zero missed deadlines and 0.001 degrees of tracking error.
